name: PD 198 was established by Ordinance No. 18671, passed by the Dallas City Council on April 24, 1985. Ordinance No. 18671 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 18671; 25508)
source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 198 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Article heading
sections.text: ARTICLE 198. PD 198.

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text: SEC. 51P-198.101.LEGISLATIVE HISTORY. PD 198 was established by Ordinance No. 18671, passed by the Dallas City Council on April 24, 1985. Ordinance No. 18671 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 18671; 25508)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text: SEC. 51P-198.102.PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE. PD 198 is established on property generally fronting on the east line of Central Expressway and the west line of Schroeder Road, south of the south line of Lyndon B. Johnson Freeway. The size of PD 198 is approximately 18.5657 acres. (Ord. Nos. 18671; 25508)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-198.103.DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.
(a)Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.
(b)Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25508)

sections.title: Conceptual Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-198.104.CONCEPTUAL PLAN. Development of the Property must comply with the conceptual plan (Exhibit 198A). (Ord. Nos. 18671; 25508)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-198.105.DEVELOPMENT PLAN. Within six months of the date of passage of this Ordinance No. 18671, a detailed development plan for either the entire PD or a designated first phase of development must be submitted to the city plan commission for approval. The detailed development plans must comply with the approved conceptual plan and the conditions of this article. (Ord. Nos. 18671; 25508)

sections.title: Landscape Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-198.106.LANDSCAPE PLAN. A landscape plan must be submitted to the city plan commission at the same time as the initial development plan is submitted, and with each subsequent development plan submitted. Each landscape plan must depict the landscaping for the area shown in the companion development plan. The Property must be landscaped in accordance with the landscape plan(s). All landscaping must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition at all times. (Ord. Nos. 18671; 25508)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text: SEC. 51P-198.107.USES. Tract I is limited to public park and playground use. Tracts II and III are limited to those uses permitted in the GR General Retail District, except that no free-standing drive-in bank is permitted west of the Cottonwood Creek channel as shown on the conceptual plan. (Ord. Nos. 18671; 25508)

sections.title: Maximum Floor Area
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-198.108.MAXIMUM FLOOR AREA. Maximum floor area for all uses combined on Tracts II and III may not exceed 1,822,124 square feet which must be divided among uses so as not to exceed the following:
(1) Office 1,422,124 * square feet
(2) Retail, bar and restaurant uses (combined) 80,000square feet
(3) Hotel ** 400,000square feet *Note: One additional square foot of office space may be permitted for a reduction of four square feet of hotel floor area for which no building permit has been issued and no permit application is pending, to a maximum of 1,522,124 square feet of office floor area with no hotel space. This rule will apply at any stage of development in addition to the office area limitations outlined in Section 51P-198.115 below. ** Note: Hotel floor area may include all uses listed as "limited uses" in an O-2 Office-2 District, subject to the provisions of Section 51-4.218. (Ord. Nos. 18671; 25508)

sections.title: Maximum Coverage
sections.text: SEC. 51P-198.109.MAXIMUM COVERAGE. Maximum coverage on Tracts II and III combined, excluding parking structures, is 40 percent, exclusive of any dedication for street right-of-way. Maximum coverage on Tract I is 10 percent, exclusive of any dedication for street right-of-way. (Ord. Nos. 18671; 25508)

sections.title: Maximum Height
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-198.110.MAXIMUM HEIGHT.
(a)Maximum permitted height for any structure is controlled by four zones shown on the development envelope plan, which is part of the conceptual site plan. If the language of this section conflicts with the dimensions or implications of the development envelope plan, the language of this section is controlling.
(b)Zone 1 is labelled "No Build Zone." No structure is permitted in this zone.
(c)Zone 2 is labelled "36.0' Max. Ht. Restriction." No structure may exceed 36 feet in height in this zone.
(d)Zone 3 is labelled "2:1 Slope Beginning." No structure may exceed one foot in height for every two feet in distance measured perpendicularly from the current rear lot lines of lots fronting on the west side of Schroeder Road, as those lots are shown on the development envelope plan. (Maximum permitted height is 150 feet at the east line of the zone and rises at a two-to-one slope to a maximum of 240 feet at the west line of the zone.)
(e)If the Schroeder Road lots referenced above are rezoned to any zoning classification other than a single-family, duplex, or townhouse district, or a PD permitting those uses, the two to one slope shall be measured from the west right-of-way line of Schroeder Road.
(f)Zone 4 is labelled "2:1 Slope Ends 240.00' Max, Ht. Restriction." No structure may exceed 240 feet in this zone. (Ord. Nos. 18671; 25508)

sections.title: Setbacks
sections.text: SEC. 51P-198.111.SETBACKS. All setbacks other than the Zone 3 slope provisions are governed by the conceptual site plan. (Ord. Nos. 18671; 25508)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text: SEC. 51P-198.112.OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING. Parking and loading must be provided for each use in accordance with Section 51-4.300. (Ord. Nos. 18671; 25508)

sections.title: Landscape Buffer
sections.text: SEC. 51P-198.113.LANDSCAPE BUFFER. A landscape buffer must be installed on Tract I along the right-of-way line of the proposed Churchill Way-Schroeder Road connection, as shown on the conceptual plan, within six months of the issuance of any certificate of occupancy for any use on the Property. Plantings must be installed in conformance with the conceptual landscape buffer section drawing and with the detailed landscape plan submitted to and approved by the plan commission as required above. (Ord. Nos. 18671; 25508)

sections.title: Building Facade
sections.text: SEC. 51P-198.114.BUILDING FACADE. No single building facade within the development may consist of more than 85 percent glass. No facade glass to be used on any structure may have an exterior visible reflectance percentage in excess of 27 percent. (Ord. Nos. 18671; 25508)

sections.title: Road Improvements And Development Timing
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-198.115.ROAD IMPROVEMENTS AND DEVELOPMENT TIMING.
(a)All right-of-way for the Churchill Way-Schroeder Road connection must be dedicated at no cost to the city. If the city acquires the right-of-way by a means other than this dedication, the owner of the Property must reimburse the city for all acquisition costs of the Property within the approved alignment for the proposed connection.
(b)No building permit may be issued for development that would result in a total of more than one million square feet of floor area on the Property (built or permitted) until the following occurs:
(1)Dedication of all right-of-way for the proposed Churchill Way-Schroeder Road connection along a city council-approved thoroughfare alignment from the northbound service road of North Central Expressway to the existing alignment of Schroeder Road north of the Property;
(2)Dedication of all right-of-way needed to construct a cul-de-sac on Schroeder Road, as depicted on the conceptual plan;
(3)Approval of engineering plans for the proposed Churchill Way-Schroeder Road connection, prepared at the property owner's expense, by the director of public works and transportation and the State Department of Highways and Public Transportation; and
(4)The owner has provided funding, in a manner acceptable to the director of public works and transportation, for the full construction cost of the bridge across North Central Expressway, connecting Schroeder Road and Churchill Way, the new roadway as a four-lane divided roadway from the bridge to the existing right-of-way of Schroeder Road, and the Schroeder Road cul-de-sac.
(c)Following the satisfaction of Paragraphs (1) through (4) above, building permits may be issued for all structures intended for uses other than office, up to the maximum permitted floor area for each use. Building permits for structures intended for office uses resulting in more than one million square feet of office uses combined may be issued only in accordance with Subsection (e) below.
(d)No certificate of occupancy may be issued for a use that would result in a total of one million square feet or more of floor area of all uses combined on the Property until construction of the Churchill Way-Schroeder Road connection is completed. Following the completion of this connection, certificates of occupancy may be issued for all permitted uses other than office, up to the maximum permitted floor area for each use. Certificates of occupancy resulting in more than one million square feet of office uses combined may be issued only in accordance with Subsection (e) below.
(e)Each of the improvements listed below is expected to justify the increased floor area of office use allowed following the improvement. The improvements may occur in any order. Building permits resulting in more than one million square feet of floor area of all office uses combined on the Property may be issued for development of up to the square footage shown below, only after construction contracts have been awarded for the stated improvement noted below. Certificates of occupancy for office uses resulting in more than one million square feet of floor area for all uses combined on the Property, may be issued totaling up to the square footage shown below, only after construction of the stated improvement is completed, according to the following schedule:
(1)147,000 square feet more than one million (in addition to any square feet allowed under Paragraphs (2) and (3) of this subsection) with improvements at Central/Coit/Forest intersection as indicated on Exhibit 198B or equivalent as approved by the director of public works and transportation;
(2)196,000 square feet more than one million (in addition to any square feet allowed under Paragraphs (1) and (3) of this subsection) with improvements to Central Expressway north of the Churchill Way bridge as indicated on Exhibit 198B or equivalent as approved by the director of public works and transportation; and
(3)79,000 square feet more than one million (in addition to any square feet allowed under Paragraphs (2) and (3) of this subsection) with DART rail line between Forest Lane and LBJ.
(f)A trapezoidal land area, beginning at the northwest corner of the Property and extending 200 feet south along the North Central right-of-way line and 80 feet east along the northern boundary line of the Property, and extending 35 feet east from the point along the North Central right-of-way line that is 200 feet south of the northwest corner of the Property, must be reserved for future improvements to North Central Expressway for ten years from the date of passage of Ordinance No. 18671. No buildings or structures may be located in this land area during the period of reservation. The portion of the described land area needed for improvements must be dedicated to the City when funding is available for the improvements and an engineering alignment indicates the need for all or a portion of this land. Any required off-street parking spaces in this area that are eliminated as a result of future dedication must be relocated with the Property. (Ord. Nos. 18671; 25508)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text: SEC. 51P-198.116.SIGNS. Signs must be in accordance with the provisions for non-business zoning districts contained in Division 51-7.400 on Tract I and within 100 feet of the right-of-way line of the proposed Churchill Way- Schroeder Road connection on Tract II. Signs must be in accordance with the provisions for business zoning districts contained in Division 51-7.300 on the remaining portion of Tracts II and III. (Ord. Nos. 18671; 25508)

sections.title: Dp&Amp;L Easement
sections.text: SEC. 51P-198.117.DP&L EASEMENT. No portion of the existing power line may be relocated onto Tract I unless it is buried below grade. (Ord. Nos. 18671; 25508)

sections.title: Thoroughfare Support
sections.text: SEC. 51P-198.118.THOROUGHFARE SUPPORT. For a period of two years after the issuance of a certificate of occupancy for a use that exceeds one million square feet of floor area of all uses combined, the owner of the Property will support any efforts of the Hamilton Park Residents' Association to open the Schroeder Road cul-de-sac by connecting it to the Churchill Way extension on the Property. (Ord. Nos. 18671; 25508)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-198.119.GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.
(a)Utilization of the Property must be in compliance with the requirements of all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city.
(b)All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.
(c)The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 18671; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text: SEC. 51P-198.120.ZONING MAP. PD 198 is located on Zoning Map No. D-8. (Ord Nos. 18671; 25508)
